claims: Italy failed to qualify for the 2026 FIFA World Cup.
Italy lost to Bosnia and Herzegovina in a penalty shootout on March 31, 2026.
Italy's loss marks a third consecutive absence from the FIFA World Cup.
The playoff final ended in a 1-1 draw.
Italy lost 4-1 on penalties in the playoff final.
Italy lost to Bosnia and Herzegovina 1-1 after regular time and 4-1 on penalties in the UEFA playoff final.
The UEFA playoff final took place in Zenica.
Alessandro Bastoni received a red card in the 41st minute.
Alessandro Bastoni's red card reduced Italy to 10 men before the penalty shootout.
Italy missed the FIFA World Cups in 2018, 2022, and 2026.
Italy is the first former champion to miss three straight World Cups.
Italy finished behind Norway in their qualifying group.
Italy last played a World Cup match in 2014.
